summary: Frontend-only verification of the new Strategy selector (Coco SmartFlow / AlphaGrid / Auralis) on Live Signals, Coco Injector and Future Signals, plus the new 2-step Future Signals flow. All primary acceptance criteria pass on both mobile (390x844) and desktop (1920x1000). Login worked with the provided sidebartest credentials.

integration_issues.issue: After clicking Generate on /live-signals and /future-signals the strategy-used chip was not found within 12s and no 'upgrade' gate text was matched either. Test account is a fresh free-tier user, so the daily quota gate (which renders as a modal, not inline text) is the most likely explanation and matches the reviewer note about expected free-tier behaviour. Injector generate button remained disabled (duration/setup step required, out of scope for this iteration).

future_signals_step1.dock_subtitle: Step 1 of 2 · pick at least one pair

strategy_images.smartflow_natural_wh: 420x560 complete=true (served as base64 data URI in production build)
strategy_images.note: Next.js inlines these small webps as data URLs — HTTP 200 check does not apply, but naturalWidth>0 and complete=true confirm they load

action_items: Optional: confirm free-tier daily quota gate behaviour on /live-signals + /future-signals Generate — modal appears but no inline 'upgrade' text; consider adding a data-testid on the gate modal so future automation can assert it explicitly.
Optional: expose a data-testid on the injector duration/setup step so downstream tests can drive it to the Inject button.
critical_code_review_comments: components/strategy-select.tsx: img has empty alt and aria-hidden on the wrapper — acceptable since the visible name/tag exist, but the is missing `loading="lazy"` which could help LCP on mobile.
future-signals-view.tsx: `scrollTop()` uses requestAnimationFrame + scrollIntoView on every phase change; harmless but could cause layout thrash on step transitions.
strategy is currently client-only state and NOT sent to /api/signals/* — confirmed intentional per reviewer note; add a TODO in the file so a future dev doesn't miss it.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the required strategy + 2-step flow checks; generate end-to-end not fully asserted due to likely free-tier gate

context_for_next_testing_agent: Strategy selector deck + Future Signals 2-step flow are all working across mobile & desktop. Only remaining gap is asserting the strategy-used chip after Generate on a paid/unlimited tier; the free sidebartest account likely trips the daily quota modal after a few runs, and that modal has no inline 'upgrade' text so use a data-testid on the gate modal or a fresh tier for that check. Injector's Inject button stayed disabled because the duration step wasn't driven — extend the test with the duration selector before pressing inject.
